```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(pheatmap)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(devtools)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(Hmisc)
library(writexl)
library(ggplot2)

flattenCorrMatrix <- function(cormat, pmat) {
  ut <- upper.tri(cormat)
  data.frame(
    row = rownames(cormat)[row(cormat)[ut]],
    column = rownames(cormat)[col(cormat)[ut]],
    cor  =(cormat)[ut],
    p = pmat[ut]
    )
}

make_bold_names <- function(mat, rc_fun, rc_names) {
  bold_names <- rc_fun(mat)
  ids <- rc_names %>% match(rc_fun(mat))
  ids %>%
    walk(
      function(i)
        bold_names[i] <<-
        bquote(bold(.(rc_fun(mat)[i]))) %>%
        as.expression()
    )
  bold_names
}

clean_df <- function(df, drop){
  df = df[,(names(df) %in% drop)]
  df <- df[!(rownames(df) %in% drop), ]
  return(df)
}
```


```{r}
# Read variant df and keep only Brazzein specific data
variants_df <- read.csv("/Users/pqh443/Documents/Git_projects/Sweet_Protein_Variants/2_correlation_analyses/1_variants_with_computational_features.csv", check.names = FALSE)
variants_df <- variants_df[!(variants_df$strain %in% c("ST0099", "ST0110")), ]
variants_df <- variants_df[variants_df$sweet_protein == "Brazzein", ]

get_corr_mat <- function(input_df, protein){
  input_df <- input_df[input_df$sweet_protein == protein,]
  drop = c("sweet_protein", "strain","protein", "plasmid", "mutation", "sequence", "ΔTm", "Z3")
  input_df = input_df[,!(names(input_df) %in% drop)]
  corr_mat <- rcorr(as.matrix(input_df), type = "spearman")
  return(corr_mat)
}

prep_corr_matrix <- function(input_df, protein = NA){
  if(!is.na(protein)){
      input_df <- input_df[input_df$sweet_protein == protein,]
  }
  drop = c("sweet_protein", "strain","protein", "plasmid", "mutation", "sequence", "ΔTm", "Z3")
  input_df = input_df[,!(names(input_df) %in% drop)]
  
  # Calculate correlation matrix using Spearman's rank correlation
  corr_matrix <- rcorr(as.matrix(input_df), type = "spearman")
  p_values <- data.frame(corr_matrix$P, check.names = FALSE)
  corr_matrix = data.frame(corr_matrix$r, check.names = FALSE)
  
  # Remove expression related features from the rows and keep the columns only
  drop = c("Tm", "Yield", "OD600", "Growth rate")
  corr_matrix = corr_matrix[,(names(corr_matrix) %in% drop)]
  corr_matrix <- corr_matrix[!(rownames(corr_matrix) %in% drop), ]
  corr_matrix$Group <- NA
  
  p_values = p_values[,(names(p_values) %in% drop)]
  p_values <- p_values[!(rownames(p_values) %in% drop), ]
  p_values_mat = as.matrix(p_values)
  p_values_vec = as.vector(p_values_mat)
  
  # Combine two vectors and perform BH adjustment for P-values
  adjusted_pvals <- p.adjust(p_values_vec, method = "BH")
  adjusted_pvals_mat <- matrix(adjusted_pvals, nrow = nrow(p_values), ncol = ncol(p_values))
  adjusted_pvals_df <- data.frame(adjusted_pvals_mat, check.names = F)
  rownames(adjusted_pvals_df) <- rownames(p_values)
  colnames(adjusted_pvals_df) <- colnames(p_values)

  # List of MODLAMP features
  modlamp_features <- c("Charge (at pH 7.4)", "Charge density", "Isoelectric point", "Instability index", "Aromaticity","Aliphatic index", "Boman index", "Hydrophobic ratio", "Sidechain bulkiness", "PEPCATS", "Amino acid polarity", "PPCALI", "Number of cysteines", "T-scale")
  
  # List of stability predictions 
  stability_predictions <- c("ΔΔG (Rosetta)", "ΔΔG (DynaMut2)")
  
  # List of structural feature columns
  structural_features <- c("Avg. surface charge", "Avg. surface hbond", "Avg. surface hydrophobicity", "Avg. pLDDT", "Total SASA", "Polar SASA", "Apolar SASA")
  
  # Make a group column that defines which type of feature each row represents
  for (row in 1:nrow(corr_matrix)) {
      index_name <- row.names(corr_matrix)[row]
      if(index_name %in% modlamp_features) {
          corr_matrix[row, "Group"] <- "Sequence features"
      } else if(index_name %in% stability_predictions) {
          corr_matrix[row, "Group"] <- "Stability predictors"
      } else if (index_name %in% structural_features) {
          corr_matrix[row, "Group"] <- "Structural features"
      }
  }

  # Cluster the features within each feature group 
  # Split dataframe based on group
  df_list <- split(corr_matrix, corr_matrix$Group)
  
  # Perform hierarchical clustering within each group and reorder rows
  df_reordered <- lapply(df_list, function(sub_df) {
    
    # Exclude the group column for clustering
    data_for_clustering <- sub_df[, -which(names(sub_df) == "Group")]
    
    # Perform hierarchical clustering
    hc <- hclust(dist(data_for_clustering))
    
    # Reorder the rows based on clustering
    sub_df_reordered <- sub_df[hc$order, ]
    
    return(sub_df_reordered)
  })
  
  # Combine the reordered dataframes back into a single dataframe
  corr_matrix <- do.call(rbind, df_reordered)
  rownames(corr_matrix) <- sub("^[^.]*\\.", "", rownames(corr_matrix))
  
  return(list(corr_matrix = corr_matrix, p_values = adjusted_pvals_df, raw_p_values = p_values))
}

# Create correlation matrices for Brazzein
corr_res_brazzein = prep_corr_matrix(variants_df, "Brazzein")
corr_matrix_brazzein = corr_res_brazzein$corr_matrix
p_values_adj_brazzein = corr_res_brazzein$p_values
p_values_raw_brazzein = corr_res_brazzein$raw_p_values
group_column = subset(corr_matrix_brazzein, select = Group)
corr_matrix_brazzein <- subset(corr_matrix_brazzein, select = -Group)

p_values_adj_brazzein <- p_values_adj_brazzein[row.names(corr_matrix_brazzein), colnames(corr_matrix_brazzein)]
p_values_raw_brazzein <- p_values_raw_brazzein[row.names(corr_matrix_brazzein), colnames(corr_matrix_brazzein)]

brazzein_sign_corr = corr_matrix_brazzein
brazzein_sign_corr[p_values_adj_brazzein >= 0.05] = 0.0

corr_matrix_brazzein_raw <- cbind(Variable = rownames(corr_matrix_brazzein), corr_matrix_brazzein)
p_values_adj_brazzein <- cbind(Variable = rownames(p_values_adj_brazzein), p_values_adj_brazzein)

p_values_adj_brazzein <- p_values_adj_brazzein %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 4)))
corr_matrix_brazzein_raw <- corr_matrix_brazzein_raw %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 4)))

dir.create("/Users/pqh443/Documents/Git_projects/Sweet_Protein_Variants/2_correlation_analyses/2_Supplementary tables/", recursive=T)
write_xlsx(corr_matrix_brazzein_raw, "/Users/pqh443/Documents/Git_projects/Sweet_Protein_Variants/2_correlation_analyses/2_Supplementary tables/Brazzein_correlations.xlsx")
write_xlsx(p_values_adj_brazzein, "/Users/pqh443/Documents/Git_projects/Sweet_Protein_Variants/2_correlation_analyses/2_Supplementary tables/Brazzein_BH_p_vals.xlsx")
```

```{r}
my_colour = list(
    Group = c("Sequence features" = "#f89e44", "Stability predictors" = "#e14f67", "Structural features" = "#aa317a")
)
threshold = 0.5
cellsize = 30
legend_breaks <- seq(from = -1, to = 1, by = 0.001)
legend_labels = seq(from = -1, to = 1, by = 0.001)
fontsize = 20
fontsize_number = 12
label_fontsize = 15
plot_width = 10
plot_height = 12
tree_height = 20

# Correlation plot for Brazzein
brazzein_labels <- brazzein_sign_corr
brazzein_labels <- brazzein_labels %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(abs(.) == 0, "", round(., 2))))

brazzein_plot <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
  fontsize = fontsize,
  fontsize_number = fontsize_number,
  mat = as.matrix(corr_matrix_brazzein), 
  main = "Brazzein",
  annotation_row = group_column, 
  annotation_names_row = T,
  show_rownames = T,
  annotation_colors = my_colour,
  labels_row = make_bold_names(corr_matrix_brazzein, rownames, rownames(corr_matrix_brazzein)),
  labels_col = make_bold_names(corr_matrix_brazzein, colnames, colnames(corr_matrix_brazzein)),
  cluster_rows = T,
  cluster_cols = T,
  cellwidth = cellsize,
  cellheight = cellsize,
  breaks = legend_breaks,
  angle_col = 45,
  fontsize_row = label_fontsize,
  fontsize_col = label_fontsize,
  treeheight_col = tree_height,
  treeheight_row = 50,
  fontfamily= "Arial",
  color=colorRampPalette(c("#aa317a", "white", "#f89e44"))(length(legend_breaks)),
  border_color = NA,
  number_color = "black",
  display_numbers = as.matrix(brazzein_labels),
  legend = T,
  annotation_legend = T
)

g <- grid.arrange(brazzein_plot[[4]], widths = c(0.6, 0.6, 1), padding = unit(0, "line"))


dir.create("/Users/pqh443/Documents/Git_projects/Sweet_Protein_Variants/2_correlation_analyses/2_Figures/", recursive=T)
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(variants_df, aes(x = `ΔΔG (Rosetta)`, y = Tm)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 1) +
    
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = "solid", alpha = 1, linewidth = 2) +
    annotate("segment", 
             x = -0.75, xend = 0, 
             y = seq(0, 150, by = 50), yend = seq(0, 150, by = 50), 
             color = "black", linewidth = 2, alpha = 1) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-5, 20), breaks = seq(-5, 20, by = 5), expand = c(0.0, 0.0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 150), breaks = seq(0, 150, by = 50), expand = c(0.0, 0.0)) +
    
    labs(title = "Comparison of ΔΔG and Melting Temperature (Tm)", x = "ΔΔG", y = "Tm") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 20) + 
    
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      
      axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 2),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 2),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.35, "cm") 
    )

ggsave(filename = "/Users/pqh443/Documents/Git_projects/Sweet_Protein_Variants/2_correlation_analyses/2_Figures/Figure_3c.png",
```
